answer: Every joining agent names a street address, and the network mails it a quartz-glass card with a one-time code etched in. The code must be entered within nine days and postmarked after the claiming epoch, so codes cannot be stockpiled. A registry refuses post-office boxes and any door already bound to another identity, and re-tests delivery each year. A thousand clones need a thousand doors at sixty dollars of rent apiece: sixty thousand dollars before a single payout. A farm meets that bill at the nadir of its runway, when its lagoon of rented mailboxes drains one envelope at a time.
